import numpy as np
import random
import itertools
import pandas as pd

# Constants
PLANETS = [
    "Mercury",
    "Venus",
    "Earth",
    "Mars",
    "Jupiter",
    "Saturn",
    "Uranus",
    "Neptune",
]
ELEMENTS = [
    "Hydrogen",
    "Helium",
    "Oxygen",
    "Carbon",
    "Nitrogen",
    "Magnesium",
    "Silicon",
    "Iron",
    "Nickel",
]


def task_func():
    planets = list(PLANETS)
    elements = list(ELEMENTS)

    if not planets and not elements:
        return pd.DataFrame()
    if not planets:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=elements)
    if not elements:
        return pd.DataFrame(index=planets)

    data = [
        [f"{planet}:{element}" for element in random.sample(elements, k=len(elements))]
        for planet in planets
    ]

    return pd.DataFrame(data, index=planets, columns=elements)
